 Ambetter from Meridian Returns to Metro Detroit for 2027 Marketplace Open Enrollment 
 Marketplace carrier returns to Wayne, Oakland, Monroe and Macomb counties, expanding plan choice and access for consumers in 2027 
 DETROIT , Nov. 12, 2026 / PRNewswire / -- Ambetter from Meridian today announced its return to the Health Insurance Marketplace in Wayne, Oakland, Monroe and Macomb counties, giving individuals and families in Metro Detroit another option as they shop for health insurance coverage for the 2027 plan year.
 The return to Metro Detroit reflects Ambetter from Meridian's continued commitment to serving Michigan communities and providing access to affordable health coverage. Consumers in the four counties can explore Ambetter from Meridian coverage options for 2027 and select a plan that meets their individual healthcare needs.
 "We're pleased to bring Ambetter from Meridian back to Metro Detroit and once again serve individuals and families in these communities," said Rebecca Daxenbichler, Plan Chief Operating Officer. "Choosing health coverage is an important decision, and our return gives consumers another option as they consider the coverage that best fits their health and financial needs for the year ahead."
 Ambetter from Meridian members will also have access to programs and benefits designed to help them access care and manage their health.
 Virtual 24/7 Care.  Members can reach an Ambetter-designated licensed provider by telehealth for conditions such as flu, fever, ear infections, skin conditions and respiratory infections, without leaving home.  
 My Health Pays®.  The My Health Pays program lets members earn rewards for completing health activities and challenges, with up to $500 in annual rewards that can be applied to copays, deductibles, and other health related expenses. Amounts and eligibility vary by state. 
 Open Enrollment for 2027 Marketplace coverage began Nov. 1, 2026. Consumers can explore coverage options, compare plans, and learn more about available benefits by visiting AmbetterHealth.com. 
 About Meridian Health Plan of Michigan, Inc. 
Meridian provides government-sponsored managed care services to families, children, seniors and individuals with complex medical needs primarily through Medicaid (Meridian), Medicare Advantage and Medicare Prescription Drug Plans (Wellcare), Medicare-Medicaid Plans, including Wellcare Meridian Dual Align (HMO D-SNP), and the Health Insurance Marketplace (Ambetter from Meridian). Meridian is a Centene Corporation  company. For more information, visit www.mimeridian.com .
